main.description: Every ballot of a secret poll, for whoever may see its counts, so that they can verify each signature under `issuer_pubkey` and count for themselves. In token order, which says nothing, and not in the order the room voted in.

open.description: While true the board can still grow.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such poll, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The poll hides its tally, and the caller does not own its context.
